sources.title: Guide Auto - GM drivers can now order their NACS adapter to use at Tesla Superchargers
sources.notes: Canadian article dated 2024-09-18: Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ owners in Canada can buy a $310 GM NACS adapter to use Tesla Superchargers.
